text: Garlic and onions are often used together in cooking as a spice mix. They can be sautéed together, combined with other ingredients to create a flavorful dish, or used as a garnish. When cooking garlic, it should be grated or chopped finely, and added to hot foods to enhance their flavor. Onions, on the other hand, can be added in moderation, chopped finely, or sliced thinly, depending on the dish and personal preference.
